languageModelTools.name: obsidian_brain
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Global knowledge store using Obsidian vault that persists across ALL workspaces. IMPORTANT: ALWAYS search brain BEFORE doing anything else - you may have solved this before. ASSUME INTERRUPTION: Your context might reset anytime - any learning NOT in brain is LOST FOREVER across ALL future sessions. MID-TASK RULE: Every 3-5 tool calls, record any decisions, solutions, or learnings to brain immediately. DO NOT batch for end. Operations: 'search' (ALWAYS first), 'list' (browse structure), 'read' (get content), 'write' (create note), 'append' (PREFERRED - add to existing), 'quick_note' (fast capture to _Inbox), 'str_replace' (edit existing), 'insert' (add at line), 'delete' (remove note), 'move' (reorganize), 'summarize_note' (TL;DR of a note), 'list_recent' (recently modified notes), 'auto_tag' (suggest/apply tags based on content), 'related_notes' (explicit shared-tag retrieval without LLM calls). Reads default to 7000 characters; pass a larger explicit max_chars if truncated. Vault structure: /Engineering/ (projects), /Playbooks/ (how-tos), /Decisions/ (ADRs), /Snippets/ (patterns), /_Inbox/ (quick notes). Use brain for LONG-TERM knowledge valuable across projects. Store workspace progress in _Workspaces/ notes using this same tool.

filepath.description: Path to the note file (required for read, write, append, str_replace, insert, delete, move)

content.description: Content to write, append, insert, or for quick_note

directory.description: Directory to list (optional for list operation, defaults to root)

old_str.description: Text to find and replace (required for str_replace)

insert_line.description: Line number for insertion (1-indexed, required for insert)

limit.description: Maximum results for search (default 15), list_recent or related_notes (default 10).

apply_tags.description: Whether to automatically apply high-confidence suggested tags (optional for auto_tag, default false)

max_chars.description: Optional read character cap (default 7000). Pass a larger explicit cap to read beyond truncation.

scripts.test: node test/acceptance.cjs && node test/mcp.cjs && node test/mcp-failure.cjs
